1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium, wherein the non-destructive medium is __water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation, wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme, wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA.

7. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

8. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of__ genotyping.

10. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated.
